code_identity_after_rebase.scope: hosts/gpu, src, vendor and root Cargo/build configuration; upstream added experiment records and design documentation only

decision.basis: Verified native instruction/code savings with inconclusive first latency, no allocation/heap change; no whole-process gate. This does not claim a new latency winner.
decision.independent_latency_confirmation_not_run: First backend latency confidence interval crosses zero; source variants clearly adverse. No unchanged rerun.

fastest_eligible_Rust.scope: Fastest explicitly documented post-JSON timer including input preparation and worker creation/run/join. Artifact restoration and JSON IO are tracked in whole-process time.

static_code.limitation: Static instructions and stack references include padding; these are not dynamic spill or CPU costs.

evidence_limits: All first and adverse results retained, including compiler/host build and source preflight failures.
Old deleted Rust source/build receipts were not fabricated: exact executable hashes were reverified against prior published pins; availability notes remain in config.
Latency source preflight failure and resource preflight correction started zero timed calls; original failed receipts retained.
Resource and profile instrumentation is excluded from authoritative latency.
Sample top-of-stack categories have a >=5 reporting threshold, include short-lived worker effects and OS sampling disturbance, and are not CPU or wall-time shares.
The full R293 experimental Mech source was reconstructed and hash verified, but only the listed applicable backend changes are imported in this update.
